description: Retrieves datasecurity table and column entries for a given DataModel in flat row format.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel to retrieve datasecurity for.

examples.user_query: What are the data security rules for the SalesAnalytics DataModel?
examples.notes: Retrieves all table and column-level security rules for the 'SalesAnalytics' DataModel. Use this to audit or review security configurations.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the data security settings for the CustomerInsights model?
examples.notes: Fetches the security rules applied to tables and columns in the 'CustomerInsights' DataModel. Useful for ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

examples.user_query: I need to check if there are any security rules applied to the MarketingData DataModel.
examples.notes: Returns the security rules for the 'MarketingData' DataModel. If no rules exist, it will return a single row with empty values and the datamodel name.

description: Retrieves detailed datasecurity rules for a specific DataModel, including share-level visibility.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel to retrieve datasecurity rules for.

examples.user_query: What are the data security rules for the Sales DataModel?
examples.notes: This call retrieves all column-level data security rules for the 'Sales' DataModel, including visibility rules for different shares.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the data security details for the MarketingAnalytics model?
examples.notes: This call provides detailed data security rules for the 'MarketingAnalytics' DataModel, showing how data is shared and restricted.

examples.user_query: I need to check the security rules applied to the FinanceModel.
examples.notes: This call fetches the detailed data security configuration for the 'FinanceModel', including any share-level restrictions.

description: Add multiple datasecurity rules to a LIVE datamodel.

datamodel_name.description: Title of the LIVE datamodel to update.

rules.description: Datasecurity rules to add in Sisense API format. Each rule typically includes fields such as ``table``, ``column``, ``datatype``, ``members``, ``exclusionary``, and ``shares``.

examples.user_query: How can I add multiple data security rules to the 'Sales_Live' datamodel?
examples.notes: This call adds two data security rules to the 'Sales_Live' datamodel, restricting access to specific regions and customer types.

examples.user_query: I need to restrict access to sensitive columns in the 'HR_Live' datamodel. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call adds two exclusionary rules to the 'HR_Live' datamodel, restricting access to the 'Salary' and 'SSN' columns for all users.

examples.user_query: How do I add rules to limit access to the 'Finance_Live' datamodel for specific departments?
examples.notes: This call adds rules to the 'Finance_Live' datamodel, granting access to specific departments and access levels.

description: Replace datasecurity rules on an EXTRACT (Elasticube) datamodel.

datamodel_name.description: Title of the EXTRACT datamodel to update.

datasecurity.description: Complete datasecurity rule list in Sisense API format. Each rule typically includes fields such as ``table``, ``column``, ``datatype``, ``members``, ``exclusionary``, and ``shares``.

examples.user_query: Update the datasecurity rules for the 'SalesData' Elasticube.
examples.notes: This call replaces all existing datasecurity rules on the 'SalesData' Elasticube with the provided rules.

examples.user_query: Set new datasecurity rules for the 'MarketingAnalytics' datamodel.
examples.notes: Use this to enforce new datasecurity rules for the 'MarketingAnalytics' datamodel, replacing any existing rules.

examples.user_query: Apply updated datasecurity rules to the 'HRAnalytics' Elasticube.
examples.notes: This replaces the datasecurity rules on the 'HRAnalytics' Elasticube with the specified rules.
